in_sanskrit.name: अरिहन्त
in_sanskrit.meaning: रuler of self, vanquisher of desires
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over himself, the one who destroys his own desires.

in_hindi.name: अरिहन्त
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who rules over himself, the one who is the king of himself.

in_tamil.name: அரிஹந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the ruler of himself.

in_telugu.name: అరిహంత
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the master of himself.

in_marathi.name: Arihant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Master, Ruler, Conqueror
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arihant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arihant is derived from the Sanskrit roots 'ari' meaning ruler and 'hant' meaning conqueror. In Hindu mythology, an Arihant is a spiritual conqueror or a Jain Tirthankara. The name is often given to children with aspirations of greatness and leadership.
